summary: The migration to veridian-ui-kit's shared shell/composer/panel/header components is largely careful and well-disclosed (veri-chat-context.tsx's rewrite as a thin wrapper around createVeriChatContext() faithfully reproduces the original composerMode/activeQueryId/activeConversationId interactions, the AppSidebar/VeriChatPanel adoption is scoped correctly to chrome-only, and the local-VeriComposer decision is a legitimate, well-documented blocker rather than a paper-over), but the diff introduces a real, confirmed, user-facing bug in a brand-new feature: the AppTopbar right-panel-toggle button (wired via layout.tsx's panelCollapsed state) does not actually collapse the VeriChatPanel. Reading node_modules/@fchecklist/veridian-ui-kit/src/shell/AppShellFrame.tsx shows the panel's fixed-width wrapper div and drag handle are rendered whenever `!isHome`, unconditional on whether the `panel` prop itself is null or a node -- so toggling `panelCollapsed` to true just empties the panel's content while leaving an ~420px blank gutter with a still-active resize handle on every one of the ~40 non-dashboard pages, rather than hiding the panel and giving the width back to main content. This is a genuinely new feature with no precedent in compliance-tracker's proven PR #471 (which never wired an onToggleRightPanel at all, per its own AppShell.tsx comment acknowledging AppShellFrame has no clean external-collapse support), so it wasn't validated by following an already-tested pattern, and PROGRESS.md's claim of 'a real working right-panel-toggle' is not accurate -- only tsc/lint/build were run, no manual browser click-through of this new control is recorded. Given this ships a visibly broken interactive control across the majority of the app's routes, this should not be auto-merged as-is.
issues: Right-panel toggle (AppTopbar onToggleRightPanel -> layout.tsx panelCollapsed -> AppShellFrame `panel` prop) does not visually collapse the panel: AppShellFrame's panel wrapper div (fixed width) and resize handle are gated on `!isHome` only, not on the `panel` prop's truthiness, so setting panel to null leaves an empty draggable gutter instead of expanding main content. Needs either a fix in veridian-ui-kit's AppShellFrame (gate the wrapper/handle on `panel != null` too) or dropping this new toggle feature from PROJEXA's layout until the shared component supports it.

Minor/disclosure gap: veri-chat-context.tsx's capability-tree fetch now re-runs on every top-level route/module change (inherited from createVeriChatContext's `useEffect` keyed on moduleScope) instead of once per session as in the prior implementation, since PROJEXA's fetchCapabilityTree ignores the moduleScope argument -- functionally harmless (redundant fetch, not incorrect data) but not called out in PROGRESS.md's 'no behavioral gain' framing.
No .github/workflows/** changes present in this diff, so the hard rule against worker-side workflow edits is not implicated.
